beyond: EX-3 adds a retry: "a question with one option only ... the job is retried once; if it fails again a debug case is written, the question's records keep waiting, and the other verdicts are applied". The owner asked for the judge's malformed questions to be fixed and for anything still counted after a landing to go to the debug workflow. Neither asked for a single retry before the debug route.

The text also makes a question without a quote of the owner's words usable ("A question without a quote of the owner's words is usable"), and says plumb takes the records of a job when a question leaves them out. The owner did not say what should happen to a malformed question at all, so these are new rules about what counts as acceptable output.
